theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Materials (+2.47%) and Real Estate (+1.30%) led the market today, while Technology (-0.32%) and Health Care (-0.31%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.26%, defensives +0.32%, and value/cyclicals +1.38% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained +0.47% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -0.59%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.41%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 8.80% to 28.68, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 1.41% to $3,598.90, crude oil was little changed at $83.96, and bitcoin gained 0.85% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
